paragraphs.text:
Y ou enter the office and see three men. They are worried and 
confused: one mutters that Amet Keh is unavailable. 
For information about Keh or the Karpathos Device, choose a 
social skill from either Charm, Fast Talk, Intimidate, or Persuade 
and make a roll: if you succeed, go to 380; fail, and return to 300.
(300, 362)
